name: Книга рецептов Мастерской на всё окно (слово автора 30.09.2026): цельный рецепт — ровный лист древней бумаги узкой полосой, три длины по числу ингредиентов, каждая в своих пропорциях; частично найденный — неровные квадратные обрывки, по одному на ингредиент; книга — гримуар чернёного пергамента во всё окно. Иконки, количество, стрелку, «?» и названия кладёт интерфейс; на арте нет ни текста, ни знаков. Бумага — на чёрном: её светлые края тёмная кромка не портит, а тёмная страница книги прячет остаток фона. Нарезка и геометрия — tools/art-gen/rbook_layers.py → RB_ART в design/ui/screens/recipe-book.js.

style: Art style: dark fantasy game art for a premium mobile RPG — ancient, rich and uneasy. Hand-painted digital painting: visible confident brush strokes, simplified planes, deep near-black shadows, rich material detail and masterful craftsmanship. Palette: soot black (#050607, #121518), graphite (#262B31), very dark old oak, blackened iron, aged bronze and old gold leaf that gleams softly, yellowed bone, deep teal velvet. Everything is heavy, worn by centuries of use, precious and made by a master: no cheap shine, no plastic, no clean saturated game-UI colors. The world lies deep under the city of Endalor, in the tower of a keeper of knowledge: vast, cold, silent and dusty. No photorealism, no 3D-render look, no anime, no cartoon, no flat vector style.
negative: No words, no letters, no digits, no numbers, no real-world alphabets, no Roman numerals, no runes, glyphs or markings that look like writing, no labels, no handwriting, no watermark, no signature, no logo, no UI elements, no buttons, no border or frame around the whole picture. No skulls, no blood, no gore. No pentagrams, no occult signs, no crosses, no religious symbols, no eyes, no faces. No people, no hands, no creatures. No candles. No purple or violet light, no neon. No bright polished gold, no glossy plastic shine.
cutout_rule: The background is one solid flat color {hex}, perfectly even from edge to edge: no gradient, no texture, no floor, no wall, no table under the object, no cast shadow, no vignette, no glow. The object itself never uses this background color and never touches the edge of the canvas.

jobs.subject: Nine separate torn fragments of one ancient parchment page lying flat, arranged in a neat 3 by 3 grid with generous empty background between them; each fragment sits alone in the middle of its own cell and never touches another. Each fragment is roughly square but irregular: jagged torn edges on two or three sides, one or two straighter edges where the page was cut, small nicks and a chipped corner; every fragment has a clearly different shape, and all of them are about the same size. The same paper as one old page: yellowed ivory to light tan, darker brown along the torn edges, faint soft crease lines, here and there a small pale stain. The middle of each fragment is calm and clean. Nothing written, drawn, stamped or printed on them: no ruled lines, no drawn border, no holes, no burns. Nothing else lies on the canvas.

jobs.title: Книга рецептов во всё окно — раскрытый гримуар чернёного пергамента, страницы пустые
jobs.source: Книга рецептов Мастерской (слово автора: «открываем на всё окно… ибо рецепты слишком важны для всей игры в целом»): на страницах интерфейс раскладывает листы и обрывки рецептов, поиск, вид и избранное
jobs.subject: One large ancient grimoire lying open, seen perfectly straight from above, centered and filling almost the whole canvas: two open pages side by side and a deep dark gutter down the middle where the pages curve into the spine. The pages are blackened vellum: very dark warm brown-black with a subtle mottled texture, slightly lighter toward the middle of each page and darker toward the gutter and the outer edges; each page has a thin double rule of dull old gold inset from its edges, with tiny corner flourishes. Around the pages only a narrow border of the cover shows: dark aged leather with worn edges and heavy dark bronze corner fittings at the four outer corners; along the outer sides and the bottom, thin layered page edges show, faintly lit cold turquoise from below. The pages are empty: nothing written, nothing drawn, no ribbon, no bookmark, nothing lying on them. The book is flat and rectangular, not tilted, and its cover never touches the edge of the canvas.

jobs.subject: One single strip torn from an ancient parchment page, lying flat and perfectly level across the middle of the canvas. It is short and wide: about three and a third times as wide as it is tall. It spans almost the whole width of the canvas, and the empty background above it and below it is each about one sixth of the canvas height. The paper is aged and warm: yellowed ivory to light tan, darker brown towards the edges, the same thickness from end to end. The two long edges are slightly uneven with a few small torn nicks, both short ends are torn raggedly with soft fibrous edges; the paper was once crumpled and later smoothed flat again, so a few faint soft crease lines cross it; a couple of faint tea-colored water stains and small foxing spots sit near the edges; the middle of the strip is calm and fairly even, so small icons can later be placed on it. Nothing written, drawn, stamped or printed on it: no ruled lines, no drawn border, no holes, no burns. Nothing else lies on the canvas: no scraps, no crumbs, no second copy.
